title: GOOD: high_cardinality_limit guard in group_metrics prevents Prometheus label explosion
description: group_metrics.rs: if the GROUP BY query returns more than HIGH_CARDINALITY_LIMIT (500) distinct groups, the per-group gauge updates are suppressed entirely and a warning is logged. This prevents unbounded Prometheus label cardinality that would OOM the metrics server. Decision: correct defensive design. The limit is a named constant and is tested.
